description: Security scanner for AI/ML model files. Detects malicious code, backdoors, and vulnerabilities before deployment

written.description: Covers the widest range of model formats of any of these, emits SARIF for a CI gate, and says plainly where its own analysis was bounded rather than reporting clean.

alive.last_commit_message:
fix(picklescan): restore Click 8.5 detection and Windows test portability (#1864)

* fix: restore Click 8.5 detection and Windows test portability

* fix: resolve compatibility exports by binding and branch

* fix(picklescan): follow reachable lazy class bindings

* fix(picklescan): resolve returned class aliases and mappings

* fix(picklescan): preserve annotated aliases and local-class coverage

* fix: resolve conditional hook returns and returned class members

* fix: fail closed on unsupported compatibility class bindings

* fix(picklescan): fail closed on method compatibility hooks

* fix: preserve active compatibility hook bindings

* fix: preserve call-graph paths across export coverage gaps

* fix: retain call paths across unresolved export bindings

* fix: retain compatibility paths across bindings and invocations

* fix: bound source condition evaluation

* fix(picklescan): bound shared metaclass traversal

* fix: retain findings across call-graph coverage errors

* fix(picklescan): preserve failures and hooks at analysis limits

* chore: clean up pickle test imports and release notes

Qualify the existing cache helper through the module import and move the
existing PR changelog entries to each Unreleased section.

Validation: 101 affected and unchanged-contract tests, full Ruff format/lint,
root mypy (495 files), and package mypy (28 files). Production source and
scanner expectations are unchanged.

* docs: keep compatibility hook changes unreleased
